description: This file handles setting the acceptance status for 'Meeting' or 'Call' objects within the SuiteCRM system. It determines the object type from request parameters, loads the appropriate bean using BeanFactory, and invokes the set_accept_status method on the bean, passing the current user and accept status. The script then outputs '1' and exits.

methods.name: set_accept_status
methods.description: Method invoked on the bean object to change the acceptance status of the meeting or call (not defined in this file, assumed part of the 'Meetings' or 'Calls' class).
